thread:
Asha: Quick final lock request for the launch blog copy in Drive (v5). Need exact CTA text + confirmation of HubSpot forms and webinar overflow plan before EOD. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/launch-v5

Mei: Skimming now. My main asks: short hero, clear benchmark callout, and two CTAs (webinar + trial).

Ravi: Bench update: p95 latency -23% vs baseline, cost per 1k tokens -17%, sustained throughput ~2.05x on Dedicated. Recommend a short parenthetical after the number: (internal test harness).

Tom: I can host the webinar. Proposed run: 20-min demo + 25-min live Q&A. Who's doing slides? Zoe/design?

Zoe: Yup, I'll export hero + chart PNGs. Need copy-approved screenshots by 3pm to hit export schedule. Request: charts at 2x and a 1200x628 hero.

Ken: HS forms: create two forms: "launch_webinar_v5" and "launch_api_trial_v5". UTMs: utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may, utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic. Webinar URL to append ?src=blog_web_v5. I'll wire zaps once forms exist.

Asha: CTA copy options (pick one exact pair):
- Option A: "Register for the live demo" / "Start your free API trial"
- Option B: "Save your seat" / "Create a trial API key"

Mei: Leaning A for clarity to enterprise readers.

Ravi: A is clearer, matches email subject lines. Also legal wants the benchmark qualifier text.

Tom: A works. Also suggest adding a small note under the webinar CTA: "Seats limited; recording sent to registrants."

Ken: Confirmed. I'll set thank-you redirect pages to include the UTM-preserving params and ensure HubSpot records the tag "blog_launch_may_v5".

Maria-ops: For capacity: cap live attendees at 350. If registrations exceed capacity, we gate the webinar and schedule two office-hour follow-ups next week (same host). Ops will auto-send recording to overflow registrants + CS drip. I can automate via HS workflows if we have the tag.

Asha: Final approval gate: voice (Mei), legal bench note (Ravi), CTAs (Ken), ops scheduling (Maria-ops). Please reply 'LGTM' by 4:30pm or flag changes.

Mei: LGTM. Tiny copy tweak: change opening line to "Today we're shipping" -> "Today we're announcing".

Ravi: LGTM from legal on the qualifier. Add exact footnote text: "Benchmarks run on Redwood internal harness; results may vary by workload and config."

Ken: LGTM. I'll create HS forms and update zaps after this thread.

Tom: LGTM. I'll drop the run-of-show and rehearsal slots in the calendar.

Zoe: LGTM. I'll upload final assets (2x charts + hero) by 3:15pm.

Maria-ops: LGTM. Scheduling publish for 2pm PT tomorrow and reserving vendor webinar room. Will confirm URLs by 5pm today.

Asha: Thanks all 44d Once Maria confirms URLs, I'll wire the CTAs in the blog and hand to growth for distribution.
